title: Automate license/provenance enforcement (attestation, provenance, disclaimer, support presence)
context: The structural check added in qpl-schema-001 validates YAML schema conformance. This task hardens the license and provenance gates: it verifies that the content inside each set is actually safe to publish — the disclaimer is present verbatim, every source referenced in provenance[] exists in sources/allow-list.yaml and has compatible terms (not reference-only for adapted content), the dual sign-off block is present and non-empty, nextReviewDue is set, and (for sensitive sets) verified support resources are referenced. These checks are currently manual gates in the review rubric; automating them in CI catches structural violations before reviewers ever see the file and makes the license gate auditable.
objective: Extend the CI check (or scripts/check-content.ts from qpl-schema-001) to enforce: (1) verbatim disclaimer present in every set; (2) every source in provenance[] cross-checks against sources/allow-list.yaml with compatible type (not reference-only if content is adapted); (3) original-authorship attestation present; (4) dual review sign-off block present and non-empty (clinician + advocate fields non-empty); (5) nextReviewDue date present and in the future; (6) for any set with a question.sensitivity field, at least one supportResources[] entry is present.
acceptanceCriteria: CI fails any published set missing the verbatim not-medical-advice disclaimer
CI fails any published set where a provenanceRefs entry references a source id not present in sources/allow-list.yaml

CI fails any published set where a provenanceRefs entry references a source that is typed reference-only in the allow-list (reference-only sources may inform authoring but must not be cited as the basis for content)
CI fails any published set missing the original-authorship attestation field
CI fails any published set where the review block's clinician or advocate sign-off fields are absent or empty
CI fails any published set missing nextReviewDue or where nextReviewDue is in the past
CI fails any published set that has at least one question with a sensitivity field but has an empty supportResources array
All checks emit a descriptive error message naming the set file and the specific failure
Existing qpl-set-001 (from M0) passes all these checks
pnpm build && pnpm test pass on a green repo state
resources: PLAN.md (Data, licensing section; Quality gates; CI gate behavior from Solution approach)
scripts/check-content.ts (qpl-schema-001 — extend this rather than creating a separate script)
output: Extended scripts/check-content.ts (or equivalent); PR with CI evidence of all 7 gate checks running
